jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Receptionist
jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at  how we (and YOU) can make that happen .

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most .

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Every salon, spa, and medspa deserves a front desk that never misses a call, never drops a message, and always knows what to say. Boulevard’s AI Receptionist is building that: agentic AI that handles client communication across voice and text so businesses can grow faster, operate leaner, and deliver an exceptional experience every time. As the product manager for AI Receptionist, you’ll own that vision end to end.

For a self-care business, the front-of-house experience is where client relationships are made or broken, so getting this right matters. It’s one of Boulevard’s highest-visibility bets, at a well-funded company early enough in its AI journey that you’ll genuinely shape the direction. Your work will have a direct, tangible impact on how thousands of small businesses show up for their clients.

What you’ll do here:

- Set the vision, roadmap, and success criteria for the AI Receptionist suite, our answer to the modern contact center for self-care businesses.

- Own how AI engages clients one-to-one across voice and text: when it handles conversations on its own, when it hands off to staff, and how that handoff feels seamless to clients and effortless for the team.

- Shape how conversations stay continuous across channels, and design fallback behavior for when AI can’t resolve something.

- Own the business outcomes (revenue, adoption, and retention) and define the product metrics behind them, like autonomous resolution rate, agent productivity, and CSAT.

- Collaborate on pricing strategy and connect what’s happening in the product to what it means for our customers’ businesses.

- Build deep fluency in how self-care businesses manage client communication today: what they trust, what they fear, and what they’d delegate in a heartbeat or never let out of human hands.

What you’ll need to thrive:

- 5-8 years in product management, with experience in B2B2C or both B2C and B2B environments, so you know what it means to serve a business and their end customer at the same time.

- Experience shipping AI-powered products: you know how to shape how AI behaves, design for when it falls short, and earn user trust over time.

- LLM fluency: enough hands-on familiarity with LLMs and prompt design to partner credibly with engineering without needing a translator.

- AI-native habits in your own practice: you use tools like Claude daily, run side projects, and stay close to how the technology is evolving.

- Strong voice-of-customer instincts, including building for users who are skeptical of automation and designing for trust.

- Data fluency: you’re comfortable defining metrics, pulling your own analysis, and building the case for roadmap bets with evidence.

- Cross-functional leadership: you’ve influenced engineering, design, and data teams without relying on authority, and kept multiple workstreams moving in parallel.

- Clear communication: you can translate complex AI product decisions for business owners, cross-functional partners, and leadership alike.

- A plus: experience with conversational AI, voice interfaces, or messaging products; vertical SaaS or services-industry platforms; AI quality evaluation; and a genuine affinity for small businesses.

How we’ll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $129,000 - $161,300 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $113,400 - $155,900 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.
How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

- Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.

- Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.

- Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.

- An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.

- 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.

- 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.

- Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.

- Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.

- $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.

- And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our  Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice .

Come Do the Best Work of Your Life at Boulevard

Every transaction that flows through Boulevard is a moment of truth — for the client who just received a service, and for the business trying to run a great operation. Commerce isn't just a feature layer; it's the transactional layer that thousands of businesses rely on to deliver exceptional client service, transact, and grow revenue. When the experience is right, it's seamless. When it's not, friction ripples from the front desk all the way into the business' books.

As Boulevard expands upmarket, supports complex franchise brands, and grows internationally, the commerce experience has to scale with it — more flexible, more reliable, and more intuitive for the operators and clients who depend on it every day. As Senior PM for Commerce Experience, you'll partner closely with a dedicated engineering and design team, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate underlying capabilities into experiences that feel obvious, trustworthy, and complete for a business and their clients. You'll bring rigor to how we measure and improve those experiences over time, using data and customer insight to continuously close the gap between where things are and where they need to be.

What You'll Bring

-5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in a B2B or SaaS environment and a track record of owning consumer-facing flows end-to-end

-Systems thinker: You connect the dots across complex workflows, multiple persona types, and technical constraints — and translate that into product decisions that feel simple to the people on the receiving end, whether that's a client completing a transaction or an operator running a multi-location business

-Commerce to close: You've owned experiences that span the full transaction lifecycle — from checkout through to  financial reporting, accounting and the other data surfaces andbusiness tools operators depend on

-Strong design partnership: You bring design in early, push the thinking together, and hold a high bar for experience quality without losing sight of what's shippable

-Bias toward outcomes: You navigate ambiguity by anchoring on what actually matters — cutting through noise to find the right problem, and measuring your work by whether it moved something real for the business or the people using it

-Cross-functional influence: You've worked effectively across product, engineering, and adjacent teams without direct authority, and you know how to move work forward when ownership lines are blurry

-Fluency with AI tools as part of your own practice — to accelerate discovery, sharpen tradeoffs, or move faster

Preferred

-Experience in vertical SaaS, or services-industry platforms

Boulevard is at an inflection point: we’re going upmarket, investing in AI, and scaling toward a much larger ambition. Every one of those paths depends on a platform that external developers, partners, and AI agents can build on, and that platform doesn’t fully exist yet. As our Senior Product Manager, Developer Ecosystems, you’ll help define it. You’ll own our integration portfolio, shape how we decide what to build versus enable versus partner on, and set our MCP strategy for AI connectivity.

This is a rare chance to shape an ecosystem that’s still early, at a well-funded company with clear market leadership in salons, spas, and medspas. Boulevard is large enough to transform the industry and small enough that your work is visible every day. What you build in the next 12 to 24 months will shape our extensibility for years to come.

What you’ll do here:

- Help define our ecosystem strategy alongside the Partnerships team: who we build for, where we play, and how we grow.

- Shape our build-vs-partner framework: when we build a core product feature, when we enable a third-party developer, and when a strategic partnership is the right answer.

- Drive alignment with executive stakeholders on where the ecosystem goes next.

- Own our integration portfolio end to end, from 1st party integrations like Shopify and QuickBooks to the developer platform and partnerships that expand what Boulevard can do.

- Shape the developer experience from onboarding through ongoing partnership, so integrations create lasting value for self-care businesses.

- Own our MCP strategy: how external AI agents and systems interact with Boulevard on behalf of businesses and clients, what we expose, and how it becomes a differentiator.

- Define what good looks like, including developer adoption, integration usage, and partner-driven revenue impact, and use those signals to refine the vision and roadmap.

What you’ll need to thrive:

- 5+ years in product management, with significant time owning developer-facing products such as APIs or developer portals.

- Experience building or scaling a developer ecosystem, and a point of view on how to sequence partner investment, where API monetization fits, and how ecosystem dynamics shift as it matures.

- A framework for when to build in-house, enable third-party developers, or pursue a strategic partnership, and a track record of applying it consistently under pressure.

- Technical fluency: you can discuss API design, webhook architecture, and MCP without engineers translating for you.

- Experience in close, shared-accountability relationships with a Partnerships or BD team, including roadmap priorities, co-development tradeoffs, and product frameworks that make partnerships scalable.

- Clear communication of complex technical tradeoffs to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership, connecting developer platform work to company priorities.

- Energy for ambiguity, with examples of bringing clarity and structure to spaces that are still taking shape.

- A plus: using AI tools in your own practice to speed up discovery, sharpen tradeoff analysis, or communicate complex decisions, and experience in vertical SaaS, services-industry platforms, or multi-tenant B2B environments.
